tool_args.rationale: Fit both positive fast and negative slow exponential contributions numerically against the five short-horizon and three slow-horizon observations. Their horizon coverage spans the stated reversal and includes the target H=19.9, so another measurement is not justified.

considered_alternatives.option: Acquire another slow-horizon or fine-trajectory probe
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The existing probe adds three horizon-spanning rows, including H=19.9, sufficient to fit and test the four-parameter dual-exponential law.
All observed s_grad values are zero, so sink coupling is unidentifiable and unnecessary for the supplied regime.
The rows show input-scaled short-horizon positive gain followed by a long-horizon sign reversal, matching the supplied history-conditioned adaptation mechanism instead.
